mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asset_wipe_records WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND status = '대기' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_wipe_records ( asset_id, employee_id, employee_name, department, asset_category, asset_model, serial_number, status, retired_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{assetId}, #{employeeId}, #{employeeName}, #{department}, #{assetCategory}, #{assetModel}, #{serialNumber}, '대기', COALESCE(#{retiredAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE asset_wipe_records SET status = '완료', wipe_method = #{wipeMethod}, performed_by = #{performedBy}, note = #{note}, wiped_at = #{wipedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt} WHERE wipe_id = #{wipeId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM asset_wipe_records WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now}
SELECT * FROM asset_wipe_files WHERE wipe_id = #{wipeId} ORDER BY file_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_wipe_files (wipe_id, original_name, stored_name, content_type, file_size, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{wipeId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
